description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance—engineered for AI‑first, edge, and serverless APIs.
npm_trending_strategy: v0.0.204‑daily is a daily‑built, zero‑dependency release that bundles native TypeScript typings, ESM‑only entry points, and built‑in AI‑middleware hooks. It adds first‑class support for edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno) and serverless platforms, while delivering sub‑millisecond routing latency and automatic observability dashboards—exactly the blend of simplicity and performance that developers search for when they type “express alternative fast”.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it lets them write Express‑style code that runs 3‑5× faster on edge and serverless platforms without any extra dependencies.
Performance: Benchmarks show <0.7 ms average request latency for 10 k concurrent routes, thanks to a lock‑free router and native ESM loading.
Developer experience: Built‑in TypeScript support, zero‑config AI middleware, live observability UI, and one‑line deployment to Cloudflare Workers, Bun, and Deno make onboarding frictionless.
